original_prompt: Design a machine gun for the game
prompt: Wide cinematic low-poly cel-shaded illustration of a stylized machine gun as hero prop, dramatic three-quarter angle, floating against a pastel purple-to-blue gradient sky with wispy geometric clouds. Bold polygonal facets in steel blue #4A6FA5 and deep navy #2D2D3D form the weapon body, coral #FF6B4A accents on barrel and grip details, amber #FFB347 glowing muzzle with volumetric light rays, mint #5BC4A0 highlights on magazine. Rich geometric environment backdrop with floating low-poly terrain fragments and sparkle particles. Dramatic rim lighting from upper right, soft diffuse fill, warm cream #F0E6D6 ambient glow. Strong focal point centered-right with the weapon heroically lit. Left third reserved as visually quiet safe zone — smooth lavender #C9A0DC gradient fade, minimal detail, muted tones for text overlay. Cheerful saturated color blocking, clean faceted shading, no outlines, vibrant harmonious palette, polished publication-ready quality, subtle depth-of-field, bold simplified geometry, no text,
refined_prompt: Wide cinematic low-poly cel-shaded illustration, dynamic action scene centered-right: stylized machine gun mid-spin suspended in air surrounded by expanding geometric shockwave rings in coral #FF6B4A and amber #FFB347, muzzle flash volumetric rays bursting outward. Weapon body steel blue #4A6FA5 and deep navy #2D2D3D bold facets, mint #5BC4A0 ejecting shell casings frozen in motion. Background vast pastel purple-to-blue gradient sky with scattered low-poly cloud fragments and floating geometric rock debris, sky blue #7EB3E0 distant mountains. Warm cream #F0E6D6 ambient glow, dramatic rim light upper right. Left third smooth lavender #C9A0DC gradient fading to quiet minimal space for text overlay. Sparkle particles everywhere, cheerful saturated color blocking, faceted shading, no outlines, no text
